remarks: Welcome to 25 Adams Avenue, in vibrant Downtown Stamford. This modern 1,200 sq ft residence offers a seamless blend of comfort and convenience and faces the quiet courtyard of the complex. Step into an inviting open-concept living space featuring two spacious bedrooms and two full bathrooms. The unit boasts a newly installed HVAC system for optimal comfort year-round. Enjoy culinary adventures in a sleek kitchen equipped with granite counters, stainless steel appliances, center island, and a custom pantry. Both the primary suite and second bedroom impress with walk-in closets complete with custom millwork. Additional amenities include in-unit washer and dryer, and balcony. Residents benefit from an attached garage and elevator. A pet-friendly policy and access to a fitness center and grills enhance the lifestyle experience. Walk to downtown, Mill River park, shops, restaurants and nightlife. Don't miss out!
